title: Furnishings Depreciation Schedule for HostCover Property-Damage Claims
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) property damage: depreciation of damaged items.**

The property depreciation share follows the plan level and the age in whole months the claim records for the damaged items: on a level whose items are paid at depreciated value, items 61 months old or older are depreciated by 60 percent, items 37 to 60 months old by 40 percent and items 13 to 36 months old by 20 percent; items 12 months old or younger, and items on a level whose items are not paid at depreciated value, are not depreciated. The percentage is taken off the verified property loss, and the guest payments and the deductible are subtracted from the depreciated property loss.

### Schedule

| Age recorded on the claim | HostCover Essential, Standard, Plus, Premier | HostCover Elite, Estate |
|---|---|---|
| 12 months or younger | no depreciation | no depreciation |
| 13 to 36 months | 20 percent | no depreciation |
| 37 to 60 months | 40 percent | no depreciation |
| 61 months or older | 60 percent | no depreciation |

HostCover Elite and HostCover Estate do not pay items at depreciated value, so no age band depreciates on those levels.

### Example (hypothetical claim)

A sofa recorded as 61 months old, verified property loss 2500.00:

- on a HostCover Standard plan, depreciated by 60 percent to 1000.00;
- had the claim recorded it as 60 months old, depreciated by 40 percent to 1500.00;
- on a HostCover Elite plan, at either age, 2500.00.
